D35ELH.Settings.enabled.Name: Enable D35E Little Helper
D35ELH.Settings.enabled.Hint: Master switch for all module features in this world.
D35ELH.Settings.actorSummary.Name: Actor and item summaries
D35ELH.Settings.actorSummary.Hint: Adds counts, estimated load, spell DCs, properties, and data warnings to D35E sheets.
D35ELH.Settings.chatEnhancements.Name: Enhanced chat rolls
D35ELH.Settings.chatEnhancements.Hint: Highlights natural d20 results, shows modifiers, adds formula copy/repeat controls, and improves D35E cards.
D35ELH.Settings.tokenHudLabels.Name: Token HUD condition labels
D35ELH.Settings.tokenHudLabels.Hint: Shows readable names beside condition icons in the Token HUD.
D35ELH.Settings.activeBuffsPanel.Name: Controlled-token buff panel
D35ELH.Settings.activeBuffsPanel.Hint: Displays active buffs for the controlled token. Right-click a buff to deactivate it.
D35ELH.Settings.sceneWarnings.Name: Scene setup warnings
D35ELH.Settings.sceneWarnings.Hint: Warns GMs about Token Vision, missing player tokens, disabled sight, and unlinked player tokens.
D35ELH.Settings.documentIds.Name: Document UUID tools
D35ELH.Settings.documentIds.Hint: Adds UUID copy actions to sheet headers and directory context menus.
D35ELH.Settings.formulaHelpers.Name: Formula validation
D35ELH.Settings.formulaHelpers.Hint: Previews resolved @data references and marks invalid roll formulas.
D35ELH.Settings.compactSheets.Name: Compact sheet spacing
D35ELH.Settings.compactSheets.Hint: Reduces empty space in D35E actor sheets.
D35ELH.Settings.autoExpandFolders.Name: Auto-expand directory folders
D35ELH.Settings.autoExpandFolders.Hint: Expands visible folders when a Foundry directory is rendered.
D35ELH.Settings.includeCoinWeight.Name: Include coin weight
D35ELH.Settings.includeCoinWeight.Hint: Includes carried currency in the estimated actor load.
D35ELH.Settings.coinsPerWeightUnit.Name: Coins per weight unit
D35ELH.Settings.coinsPerWeightUnit.Hint: Number of coins equal to one D35E weight unit. The 3.5e default is 50.
